correctness.rationale: The explicit 3-by-3 extragradient matrix has singular squares k,k,1 for a unit payoff row, with k=1-h²+h⁴. For a period, the squared product is a rank-two positive update of k²I and its Gram trace/determinant give the three stated singular values. The exact derivative difference 4(1-c²) proves unique minimization at h=1/sqrt(2) for c<1; h>1 is excluded via the minimum singular value bound. Endpoints, c=1, c=0 and angular asymptotic are proven. A standalone verifier passed 16131 checks, including exact symbolic and rational identities. Finite samples are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Two distinct rank-one bilinear games form the minimal periodic setting with rotating neutral subspaces. Exact singular values and the sharp angle-independent h=1/sqrt(2) choice answer a robust two-update stepsize question not resolved by qualitative convergence. The sharp angular degeneration theta²/14 quantifies loss of effective excitation. This provides a self-contained structural test case and exact tuning guarantee, without claiming asymptotic or runtime gains.
